metadata.title: Here’s What This Veteran Bond Investor Monitors Instead of Treasuries <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Economist Mohamed El-Erian Monitors South Korea, U.K. Bonds, and the Yen
Economist and veteran bond watcher Mohamed El-Erian worries about a spike in borrowing costs, especially as the Japanese yen slumps and the Iran war heats up again.
